name: Tamsin
fantasy: A rink-keeper from the high frosts. She runs the fight on the ice, chills everything she touches, and raises a sliding rink-wall that her squad can shelter behind.
silhouette: the big furred collar and the long trailing scarf, on blade skates

card.loop: Every hit Chills. Knock a Chilled foe and they splinter for area damage. Rinkrun to double your fan's darts, and shelter the squad behind the Rink Wall.
card.dash: Rinkrun: hold Shift to glide fast; let go early to get some of the cooldown back.
card.passive: Hoarfrost: damage Chills for 4s. Knock a Chilled foe and it splinters, hurting those near it.
card.lmb: Hoar Fan: hold for a flurry of homing shards ending in three heavy ones; eight on one foe makes them splinter. Double damage during a Rinkrun.
card.rmb: Sleet Lance: lands, slows, then goes off again. Close hits slow more, far hits hurt more. 2 charges.
card.e: Rink Wall: a sliding ice wall that stops shots and shoves foes; press again to freeze it. Friends get a shield.

weapons.hoar_fan: A flurry of 4 light shards then 3 heavy ones. Eight shards on one foe splinter them.

passive.name: Hoarfrost
passive.desc: Your damaging abilities Chill foes for 4s (a Chilled foe is a little slower and shows frost). Knocking a Chilled hunter, or felling a Chilled monster, makes them Splinter 0.4s later: 30 damage to everyone within 3m of them, plus Chill. Eight shards of your fan on the same foe Splinter them too, for 20.

dash.name: Rinkrun
dash.desc: Hold Shift to Rinkrun at 11 m/s in the direction you face, for up to 1.6s, steering gently. Let go and you stop; stopping early gives back a share of the cooldown. Your fan does double damage during a Rinkrun. In the air this is your usual long dash.

variants.tap: Throw a lance 12m. It bursts where it lands (12 damage, Chill, a slow that is stronger up close while the damage is stronger from far), then goes off again 0.7s later for 15 in 1.8m.

e.name: Rink Wall
e.desc: A 4.2m ice wall appears ahead and slides forward for 4s, stopping shots and shoving foes it touches. Press E again to freeze it where it stands (it then lasts 8s). Teammates who touch it get an 18 point frost shield for 6s, once per wall.

rank3.sec: the lance's second burst is 45% larger
rank3.dash: a Rinkrun over open sky lays a short ice bridge
rank3.kin: the wall is 40 points tougher and its frost shield doubles

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 4.5s -> 3.4s, damage +30%; the second burst is 45% larger.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 11s -> 8.8s; a Rinkrun over open sky lays a short ice bridge.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 20s -> 16s, wall strength +30%; +40 wall strength and a doubled frost shield.

tells.full: a foe with 6+ fan shards on them glitters; Splinter rings white
tells.dash_spent: skate blades dark, dash pip dark
